attribute_fields.COMMENTS: South Carolina state income tax calculation. Implements progressive tax structure per SC tax code (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix:
"South Carolina Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto
result.agi result.sc_standard_deduction_single sub 0 max /result.sc_taxable_income xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Taxable income in bracket 1; SC taxable income under or equal to $3,560
Taxable income in bracket 2; SC taxable income over $3,560 and under or equal to $17,830

action_details.action_postfix:
0.0 /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"SC Bracket 1 (0%): $" result.state_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

result.sc_bracket_1_limit result.sc_bracket_1_rate mul result.sc_taxable_income result.sc_bracket_1_limit sub result.sc_bracket_2_rate mul add /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"SC Bracket 2 (3%): $" result.state_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

result.sc_bracket_1_limit result.sc_bracket_1_rate mul result.sc_bracket_2_limit result.sc_bracket_1_limit sub result.sc_bracket_2_rate mul add result.sc_taxable_income result.sc_bracket_2_limit sub result.sc_bracket_3_rate mul add /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"SC Bracket 3 (6%): $" result.state_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: South Carolina military retirement pay exclusion. Full exemption for all military retirement income (Group B). MSRRA compliant. SCRA compliant. SBP payments fully exempt. National Guard drill pay withholding optional.

initial_action.action_postfix: "SC Military Retirement Exclusion Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto
initial_action.action_comment: Initialize SC military retirement exclusion calculation

action_details.action_comment: Full exclusion - 100% of military retirement pay excluded from SC taxable income. Note: National Guard drill pay withholding is optional.
action_details.action_postfix:
taxpayer.military_retirement_pay get /result.sc_military_retirement_exclusion xdef
result.sc_subtractions get result.sc_military_retirement_exclusion get add /result.sc_subtractions xdef
"SC Military Retirement Exclusion (Full): $" result.sc_military_retirement_exclusion get cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No military retirement pay - no exclusion
action_details.action_postfix: 0 /result.sc_military_retirement_exclusion xdef "SC Military Retirement Exclusion: None (no military retirement pay)" job.audit_trail swap addto
